lines.ref: This is Makayla.

She is a nineteen
year old unemployed
dropout now.

Why is she in such a
pickle you may ask?

Well just last month
her creative writing
professor told her

to never try to become
a professional author
because she won’t “make it”.

And because Makayla
is such a petty bitch

that likes to clap
back at men,

she is determined
to prove him wrong.

So she dropped
her classes for
next semester,

finally quit her
mind numbing job,

and thought of an
absolute banger
book idea.
✨Imagine a world✨
where a witch

strikes a deal
with a Crown Prince

that promises
her freedom.

Only, she isn’t after
freedom...
...she’s after revenge.

And has some crazy
ass plans to manipulate
his feelings,

and infiltrate his palace
through marriage

to take down his
family’s corrupt legacy.
Pretty epic right?

So Makayla has
spent the past
month writing

to deliver this book
to the die-hard fans
of Powerless & ACOTAR

Because not only is
she going to be a
bestseller to prove her
professor wrong...

she is going to be
a bestseller in the
romantasy genre to
haunt him even more.

So she calls upon the
book girlies that are
not just interested
in her story...

...but interested in
forming an alliance.

An army of book
girlies, if you will

that think standing
up for our art,
stories, and dreams
against mean ass men
is important.

Makayla asks that
you wish her luck
and follow along
if you’re ready to see

a journey full
of imposter
syndrome,
writers block,

and most of all
really fucking hard work 🫶

audit.notes: This video relies entirely on a pre-recorded CapCut automated text-to-speech voiceover narrating a highly specific personal backstory and fantasy book pitch. Furthermore, it incorporates nine consecutive fantasy novel concept art stills, actual physical book covers, and plot outlining boards that cannot be substituted with generic lifestyle clips.
audit.summary: A writer introduces herself and her journey using a third-person CapCut TTS voiceover, recounting how she dropped out of college out of spite after a professor doubted her, pitching her upcoming romantasy novel with fantasy art illustrations, and inviting book lovers to follow along.
